q: Separation of crude oil takes place in a ______ into different fractions in an oil refinery.
e: Separation of crude oil takes place in a fractional distillation column into different fractions in an oil refinery. Distillation separates liquids by boiling point, then condenses the vapour. Combustion chamber would fill a different blank than fractional distillation column.

q: In fractional distillation, the fractions condense and come out of the column at different heights depending on their ______.
e: In fractional distillation, the fractions condense and come out of the column at different heights depending on their boiling points. Boiling is liquid to gas throughout the liquid at the boiling point. Densities would fill a different blank than boiling points.

q: The petroleum gas fraction comes out first at the top of the column because its molecules have the ______.
e: The petroleum gas fraction comes out first at the top of the column because its molecules have the lowest boiling points. Boiling is liquid to gas throughout the liquid at the boiling point. Greatest density would fill a different blank than lowest boiling points.

q: The residue at the bottom of the fractional distillation column is used to make bitumen for ______.
e: The residue at the bottom of the fractional distillation column is used to make bitumen for surfacing roads. Surfacing roads is the idea that completes this fact. Plastic bottles would fill a different blank than surfacing roads.

q: All the fractions from crude oil distillation are insoluble in water and ______ in air.
e: All the fractions from crude oil distillation are insoluble in water and burn in air. Burn is the idea that completes this fact. Dissolve would fill a different blank than burn.

q: Petrol (gasoline) has an approximate boiling point range of ______ °C.
e: Petrol (gasoline) has an approximate boiling point range of 35~75 °C. 35~75 is the idea that completes this fact. 500~600 would fill a different blank than 35~75.

q: Kerosene (paraffin) is used as a fuel for ______.
e: Kerosene (paraffin) is used as a fuel for jet aircraft. Jet aircraft is the idea that completes this fact. Space rockets would fill a different blank than jet aircraft.

q: Lubricating oil contains approximately ______ carbon atoms per molecule.
e: Lubricating oil contains approximately 19~35 carbon atoms per molecule. 19~35 is the idea that completes this fact. 1~4 would fill a different blank than 19~35.

q: Fuel oil is used as a fuel for ships, factories and ______.
e: Fuel oil is used as a fuel for ships, factories and central heating systems. Central heating systems is the idea that completes this fact. Laboratory burners would fill a different blank than central heating systems.

q: Refinery gas is used as bottled gas for gas cookers and ______.
e: Refinery gas is used as bottled gas for gas cookers and motor cars. Motor cars is the idea that completes this fact. Electric stoves would fill a different blank than motor cars.

q: Naphtha is primarily used to make ______.
e: Naphtha is primarily used to make petrochemicals. Petrochemicals is the idea that completes this fact. Fertilisers would fill a different blank than petrochemicals.

q: Diesel oil has an approximate boiling point range of ______ °C.
e: Diesel oil has an approximate boiling point range of 250~340 °C. 250~340 is the idea that completes this fact. 35~75 would fill a different blank than 250~340.

q: Bitumen is a black substance used to make surface roads and ______.
e: Bitumen is a black substance used to make surface roads and roofing. Roofing is the idea that completes this fact. Synthetic rubber would fill a different blank than roofing.

q: The fraction with the smallest molecules is ______.
e: The fraction with the smallest molecules is refinery gas. Refinery gas is the idea that completes this fact. Naphtha would fill a different blank than refinery gas.

q: The most viscous fraction from crude oil distillation is ______.
e: The most viscous fraction from crude oil distillation is bitumen. Bitumen is the idea that completes this fact. Diesel oil would fill a different blank than bitumen.
